cases.name: bind-4
cases.refusal:
Refusing to serve on  without authentication.
  This API can create profiles, launch browsers and export cookies, and
  on a non-loopback address anything that can reach the port can use it.
  Fix it with either:
    numera token create "<what it is for>"   (recommended)
    set NUMERA_API_TOKEN=<secret>
  Then set NUMERA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS if a browser page will call it.
  To bind anyway - only when something else in front already
  authenticates - set NUMERA_ALLOW_INSECURE_BIND=1.
